review_text_raw:
I enjoy mystery/investigation and hacking games, so I was looking forward to trying this one out for a while. That said, I didn't have high expectations going in to this game because it doesn't cost that much. 
However, I wouldn't recommend this game for the following reasons:

1. My choices didn't matter and there was only one correct answer. I was excited to play this because I thought it would have a multi-layered investigation, like "The Roottress are Dead," but it's far short of that. Grabbing data from various documents is the main mechanic, which lead to "inferences," which are mostly guesswork to get the right answer so you can go forward. There were no consequences to getting something wrong, thus no multiple endings.

2. The story lines for the two missions I played were kinda gross to me. [spoiler] Both centered on blond, white women. In the first mission, the woman lied about her domestic abuse and scammed multiple husbands. And in the second the woman was a college student who was forced to be a "sex slave." This trite theme was repulsive to me and not fleshed out in an interesting way.[/spoiler] I quit playing because I lost interest in the overarching story or how the missions were connected.

3. The scripts (and some of the corresponding voice acting) were really bad. They didn't suit the characters at all, so much so that it broke my immersion.
